title: fix(plugin-charts): a two-dimension pie, donut, funnel or treemap draws every group or refuses, never the first group alone
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_

Fixes #27563

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表板的矩形树图拿到两个维度（例如 阶段 × 负责人，金额求和）时，按「阶段 → 负责人」两级嵌套画出每一格；饼图、环形图、漏斗图拿到两个维度时不再只画第一个负责人的数，而是在磁贴上显示拒绝说明，并点名每一个负责人分组。
- 为什么改：第二个维度被透视成多条序列，这四个图表分支只读第一条，其余分组静默丢掉，看起来像一张完整的图。裁决是「每组都画，或者拒绝，绝不出半张图」：树图原生支持嵌套，所以画全；饼图一圈只能表达一个整体的份额、漏斗每段只能是一个总数，没有放第二条序列的位置，所以拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只动这四个图表分支和仪表板组件给这几类图传的序列；单维度图表画法不变，对比叠加（compareTo）不算分组，没有数据时仍是原来的空图。仪表板外带多个度量的饼图/漏斗（例如手写多条 yAxis）现在也会拒绝、树图会按度量嵌套，见 Acceptance notes 第一条，请席位确认；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` 的 `buildTreemapGroups`、`OneSeriesFamilyRefusal` 和 pie/funnel/treemap 分支开头；`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` 的 `chartSeries`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.twoDimensionSingleSeries-27563.test.tsx packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.twoDimensionSingleSeries-27563.test.tsx`，预期 32 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A dashboard widget (or dataset-bound chart) of type `pie`, `donut`, `funnel` or `treemap` with `dimensions: ['stage', 'owner']` and one measure reaches the renderer pivoted by `buildChartSeries`: one row per stage, one series per owner. These four arms read `series[0]` alone, so they drew the first owner's amounts as if they were the whole chart. Triage's rule (the same as #27460): draw every group, or refuse a shape the chart cannot draw; never a partial chart. Per family:

- **Treemap: draws every group.** Nesting is native to Recharts' `Treemap`, so two or more groups are drawn as two levels (`buildTreemapGroups`, the treemap counterpart of #27560's `buildSankeyCellFlows`): each stage is a parent, each owner it has records for a leaf inside it, sized by the measure. A leaf is named `stage / owner` (the title the dashboard's drill gives the same cell; a parent's own name is painted over by its leaves) and takes its stage's colour. A combination the dataset did not answer is no leaf and no omission. A carried cell that cannot be sized is left out and the existing `unsized-rows` note is printed once per owner that lost one; no sizable cell at all is the existing `no-positive-magnitude` refusal, now naming every owner it tested. Clicking a leaf drills to its cell (`{ category, series }`, as the two-level sankey's flow click does).
- **Pie, donut, funnel: refuse on the tile.** A pie's angle is one share of one whole and a funnel stage one total, so a second series has no place on either; a second ring or a stacked funnel would be a new visual with its own legend and colour contract, which this card does not decide. Handed two or more groups with rows to draw, these arms now return `OneSeriesFamilyRefusal` in the existing `ChartRefusal` shell (`role="status"`, `data-chart-error="one-series-family"`): "A pie draws one series, and this chart carries 3: `Ann`, `Bo`, `Cy`. Drawing only the first would hide the others, so none is drawn." Every group is named, and the sentence stays true if the series are measures rather than groups.
- **Which series are groups.** `groupSeries` (the sankey's `sankeyFlowSeries`, renamed and shared) drops a comparison overlay, so a `compareTo` treemap stays one level.
- **The dashboard hands these families one measure.** `DatasetWidget` already handed a sankey only the measure it renders (#27560); the same filter now covers every `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_FAMILIES` family. A stored widget of these types that declares several measures with one dimension (refused at publish by the spec's single-series arm since 17.7.0) therefore still draws its first measure, and the dropped-measure console warning stays true, instead of its second measure being read as a group. A pivot carries one measure, so nothing is dropped from it.

Unchanged: every one-dimension chart of the four types (regression pins below), the empty-rows path, the sankey.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.twoDimensionSingleSeries-27563.test.tsx` (20): the fixture is a real `buildChartSeries` pivot (stage × owner, sum amount). Treemap: one leaf per answered cell with its size, shared stage colour, the per-owner note for a cell at -5, the magnitude refusal naming every owner, the leaf click's drill event; pie/donut/funnel: no `Pie`/`Funnel` element rendered and the refusal names every owner; regression pins per family for one dimension, the compared treemap, and no rows. Marks are read from the props each Recharts element was rendered with, not jsdom pixels.
- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.yAxisUndrawn-10691.test.tsx`: `draw` settles on the plot or the renderer's refusal, and the pie control asserts the one-series refusal (see Acceptance notes).
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.twoDimensionSingleSeries-27563.test.tsx` (12): the card's widgets through `DatasetWidget` → `SchemaRenderer` → `AdvancedChartImpl`: the treemap draws 5 depth-2 leaves, pie/donut/funnel refuse naming every owner, a one-dimension widget of each type draws, and a stored one-dimension widget with two measures still draws (no group refusal, no nested treemap).

## Acceptance notes

- **Mechanism measured, premise holds.** On `origin/main` (`525ea3632`) the renderer file swapped in: the treemap drew 3 one-level leaves with no children, and pie, donut and funnel each rendered one `Pie`/`Funnel` element bound to the first owner's column (15 of the 32 new tests red, every control green).
- **Refusal on the tile, not at publish.** Triage's text says "refuse at publish". A publish-time refusal of a second dimension on these types is a spec door (`packages/spec`, outside this card); the tile refusal meets "never a partial chart" today and names every group. Whether the spec should also refuse the shape at publish is the seat's call.
- **⚠ Seat to confirm: charts outside the dashboard that carry several MEASURES.** `AdvancedChartImpl` cannot tell a pivoted group from a second measure; it reads two or more non-comparison series as groups, as #27560 made the sankey do. The dashboard hands these families one measure (above). Two other shapes reach the arms with several measures and change too: a chart block that authors a `yAxis` list on a pie, donut or funnel, and a page chart bound to a dataset with ONE dimension and TWO measures (`checkDashboardWidgetChartMeasureArity` is attached to the dashboard widget schema only, so no spec door refuses either there). Both used to draw their first measure silently, a partial chart; a pie, donut or funnel now shows the one-series refusal naming every measure, and a treemap nests the measures under each category. Measured: `ChartRenderer.yAxisUndrawn-10691.test.tsx`'s control "(control) pie, three entries: no note" settled on a drawn `svg`, which the pie no longer draws; its subject (no y-axis note on a pie) still holds, so the helper now settles on the plot or the refusal and the control also asserts the refusal. If the seat wants those multi-measure charts kept drawing their first measure, the alternative is to mark pivot series in `buildChartSeries` (`@object-ui/core`, a published type: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`) and refuse only on that marker.
- **Copy is English**, matching every sibling refusal in this file (`no-positive-magnitude`, `no-positive-flow`, `missing-series-key`); no locale keys added.
- A third dimension still collapses into the (d0, d1) cell, as the card notes; untouched.
- **File surface:** `DatasetWidget.tsx` is touched for the measure filter (the line #27560 added for the sankey, widened) and two comments, not for a refusal note; the Claim lists the file conditionally.

## Verification

The treemap drew three one-level leaves (`Prospect`, `Proposal`, `Won`) with no children; pie, donut and funnel each rendered one `Pie` / `Funnel` element (bound to the first owner's column).
- Widget measure filter alone at base (renderer fixed): 8 failed: the four "stored one-dimension TYPE with two measures still draws its first measure" controls, and the four `fires iff the second measure's values leave the drawn chart unchanged` rows of `DatasetWidget.singleSeriesMeasures-11417.test.tsx` for pie, donut, funnel and treemap.
